summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the launch of an offering of new unsecured senior notes. The amount and terms are not yet determined. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes including repayment of revolving credit facility debt, capex, investments, and acquisitions. The notes will be rated BBB- by S&P and Fitch. Completion is subject to market conditions and TASE registration. The offering is exempt from U.S. registration under Rule 144A and Regulation S. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
